dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Well hello there, my dear partner. How have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Remember, if you ever find yourself caught up in some strange case, just notify me immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks for looking out for me.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: But no need to worry, I'd say the peace and quiet you have here makes it an even better vacation spot than Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Too bad there are no cases to crack, though... It's almost too serene. Lacks a little intrigue.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Oh — no no, that's my problem. Gah, look at me, making you feel bad...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: ...Hey, I have an idea! I think it'll give me a chance to redeem myself and serve as something fun to do.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Let's play a little game of mine!

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Here's how it works: After you return here each day, I'll try to guess what you did that day, what you ate... even who you saw.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: If I win, you'll think of something to do for me. But, if I lose, then I'll treat you to the best Kushikatsu place I know. How's that sound?

choices.text: Is there anything I can do for you?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Oh? Well, I guess there is one thing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Sure, of course! I've actually been waiting to give you a taste of the old Heizou treatment.

choices.text: Wait... a taste of what now?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Haha, no no no no, you've got it all wrong. You see, I've been hanging around here for a while now.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: And whether it's from the more obvious details like the style and arrangement of your space, or the more subtle details like the type of decorations you've set out... Just by looking around, I've already gathered a lot of info about you.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: I have deduced that not all the arrangements here is based on your personal taste, no... on the contrary, some of it is intentionally done with visiting friends in mind.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: As for what led me to this conclusion...

choices.text: Amazing! You really are quite the detective.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Oh? Using a compliment to change the subject, are we?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: It appears you have some secrets that you'd prefer to leave unspoken.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: In that case, let me start by telling you about myself. Now, where to begin...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: You've already heard about who I am and who my connections are. And I'm sure you know my general likes and dislikes after all this time together...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: As for my family background, I'm guessing you're not too interested in that...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Ah, how about this! I'll tell you my weakness.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you even have a weakness?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: You betcha. Don't let my usual rational appearance fool you. It turns out that I'm easily swayed by emotion.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: People have this real... glow about them when they're doing something they believe in, you know? They stand out in the world, like Flaming Flowers. And they make it a brighter place.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: That's why I strive to keep those people safe from anyone looking to take advantage. Call me crazy, but when I see something beautiful, I wanna keep it that way.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: By the way, you've got that spark in you too. It's hit me a few times in our time together, I could genuinely feel it.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Shh! That's my weakness, okay? So be sure to keep this one top-secret.

choices.text: I want to gather info about you, too!

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Oh? Trying to change the subject, are we?

choices.text: Is that a dressing down... or a beatdown?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I was just about to head out for a bit. Care to join me, my dear partner?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: But the trip might be a little inconvenient. First, we'll have to go into town and buy a few things we'll need. After that, we'll head out of town for a while, and we'll likely need to return to the Police Station again before the day's through...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you going to arrest a criminal?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Excellent question! But naturally, the answer is no. I'll leave that task of apprehending criminals to colleagues who specialize in that kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Actually, I was thinking of visiting the relatives of some convicted criminals. Some of them are elderly folks, some of them are just kids.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: It was my conclusive evidence that landed their relatives in prison. If it wasn't for me, then they wouldn't be left all on their own now...

choices.text: You shouldn't feel guilty about that...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Haha, don't worry. I know very well that the criminal is the one who should feel guilty.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Catching the culprit is what Detective Heizou is all about.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: But when it comes to regrets... *sigh* I only regret that I couldn't stop the tragedy by nipping the crime in the bud.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: For now, while the criminals are serving their time at correctional facilities, I'll help look after their families.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: After all, speaking just as plain old Heizou here, I'm a firm believer in helping those in need and being kind to other people.

choices.text: So you're gonna go pay them a visit with some gifts?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Oh no, that wouldn't work out well. Tensions tend to rise the moment they see my face. There's a chance they would even start throwing punches at me.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: You see, my intention is to just show them some care, so it's better not to reopen any old wounds.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Better if I just leave the items with a letter on their doorstep.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Anyway, we'll leave once you're ready.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: My intuition tells me that with you coming along, this will be the smoothest and most enjoyable trip yet.

choices.text: Or were you just gonna leave the stuff on their doorstep?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Hehe, as my partner, I knew you'd catch on. You're already thinking a step ahead before I've explained anything.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: With the way we understand each other, it'd be waste of time to elaborate.

choices.text: Wow, you really care a lot for them...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Yes. Of course, it's Detective Heizou's duty to establish the truth.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: But once the case is solved, the criminal's family are the ones who will face public ridicule and discrimination.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Of course, it's my hope that they can move on from the events of the case sooner rather than later and just continue on with their lives.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Heizou!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}! Sleep well? Did you have any dreams? If so, what did you see?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hehe... seriously, if you've got a moment, I'd love to hear all the details.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodnight, Heizou.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: You look pretty worn out, get some sleep! It can be dangerous not getting enough rest, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: *yawn* Uh-oh, seems you're not the only one, I'm feeling a little tired now myself.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Aha, an open-air hot spring! Hmm, judging from the amount of steam, I can reasonably infer that the water is perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: When I'm soaking in a hot spring, my inspiration soars like steam rising from the hot water.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I gotta say, this is fantastic. Seems you really know how to live it up.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Wow, the layout and style here really are something! All that's missing is some special lighting...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: But the room really has a certain intrigue to it. Imagine: "poof," the lights go out... "Bang! Bang! Bang!" A knock at the door, suddenly the wardrobe starts creaking... Then you hear a faint, raspy voice coming from beneath the bed...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Haha, it'd be a great setting for a murder mystery party, don't ya think?
